headline: Discussion of the draft 2027 Comprehensive Plan's municipal infrastructure section and the structure of boards, committees, and commissions.
summary: Draft maps and chapters on transportation, energy, and facilities are part of the infrastructure discussion. Updates from the mayor, the Inclusion and Belonging Commission, and city staff are also on the list.
items: Public comment on topics not on the agenda
Discussion of the Comprehensive Plan municipal infrastructure section, with draft maps and chapters on transportation, energy, and facilities
Discussion of the review of boards, committees, and commission structure, with a staff memorandum
City updates from the mayor, the Inclusion and Belonging Commission, and city staff
